evals.prompt: Review launch readiness. The complete required asset set is one homepage using the supplied synthetic SSOT excerpt, canon v2026-09-01: core/00-what-it-is.md category is payment risk analytics; core/02-product.md capabilities say review risk before authorization; living/07-evidence.md approves no quantified outcome. Returns an individual asset verdict and launch verdict with reviewed scope
